name: subagents-own-copy
title: Two kittens write in a copy of their own and the thread merges them
about: The agent starts two kittens with placement own_copy in a git project. Each card says it works in its own copy on its own branch. Both write a file and commit; the thread is woken, merges both branches (the fake CLI runs a squash merge for each branch a report names) and ends. Both branches and both copies exist, the merge is the thread's own run's change (two files), the person's checkout is untouched, and undoing the thread's run leaves the kittens' branches and copies alone.

steps.text:
Write two files [fake:delegate] mcp neko start_subagent {"title":"Write a","prompt":"[fake:steps]
write a.txt one
sh git add -A && git -c user.name=Kit -c user.email=kit@example.com -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm work","placement":"own_copy"} ; mcp neko start_subagent {"title":"Write b","prompt":"[fake:steps]
write b.txt two
sh git add -A && git -c user.name=Kit -c user.email=kit@example.com -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm work","placement":"own_copy"}

steps.expect: Two cards appear in the conversation
Each card says it works in a copy of its own, on its own branch
Both reports wake the thread, which merges both branches and says what it read
The thread's merge is its own run's change: two files

steps.name: merged
steps.expect: Two cards in a copy of their own, the notes and the merge's change line

sh.run: git -C files/acme-api ls-tree -r --name-only "$(git -C files/acme-api for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' 'refs/heads/neko/*-1')" | tr '\n' ' '
git -C files/acme-api ls-tree -r --name-only "$(git -C files/acme-api for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' 'refs/heads/neko/*-2')" | tr '\n' ' '

steps.expect: Both branches exist in the repository, each with its own file, and both copies are kept
The person's own checkout is untouched
Undoing the thread's merge works: its run reads undone

sh.run: git -C files/acme-api for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)' 'refs/heads/neko/*-[12]' | diff - refs-before.txt && echo same

steps.expect: Undoing the parent's run leaves the kittens' branches and copies alone
